name: Paperclip

runner.notes: Install via `npx paperclipai onboard --yes` (or `paperclipai test-drive` for an isolated instance), local_trusted loopback mode, authenticate at least one guest coding CLI (e.g. Claude Code or Codex) outside Paperclip, create a company with a single engineer agent on that adapter, point the project workspace at runs/<run-id>/worktree only, file prompt.md as one issue assigned to that agent, let heartbeats run to completion, then harness-verify the directory the agent actually edited (execution workspaces may be git worktrees). Record paperclipai version (e.g. 2026.916.1), adapter type, workspace/worktree mode, heartbeat settings, and human interventions (approvals count).

inclusion: Class A self-hosted multi-agent control plane: MIT Node.js server + React UI that runs guest coding CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, OpenCode, Pi, Grok, Kimi, Hermes) as heartbeat-driven 'employees' on ticketed issues with git-worktree execution workspaces, GitHub project repositories, dev-server/preview runtime services, budgets and approval gates. Positioned as an 'AI company' / agents-at-work orchestrator (non-coding functions such as marketing/support are also advertised), but unlike excluded Macro its execution substrate is coding-CLI orchestration in isolated git workspaces, so it is cataloged as a peer rather than excluded.
runtime_model_notes: Official adapters launch local CLIs as subprocesses (claude_local, codex_local, gemini_local, cursor, opencode_local, pi_local, grok_local, kimi_local, hermes_local) or call remote agents (openclaw_gateway, http); PRODUCT.md: 'does not mandate an agent runtime'. Adapter ids ship in-repo under packages/adapters.
pricing_model: Free and open source (MIT), self-hosted; no Paperclip account required. BYO guest agent subscriptions/API keys. Repo docs reference an optional 'Paperclip EE' for richer skill-policy administration; no public pricing found in this pass.
public_stack_signals: README: 'Node.js server and React UI that orchestrates a team of AI agents to run a business'; embedded PostgreSQL locally, external Postgres in production.

Workspaces & Runtime: 'isolated execution workspaces (git worktrees, operator branches), and runtime services (dev servers, preview URLs)'.

setup_notes: Quick try: `npx --registry https://registry.npmjs.org paperclipai onboard --yes`; isolated: `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=... npx paperclipai test-drive` (or `--harness codex`).
Managed install: https://paperclip.ing/install.sh (checksum published alongside) installs CLI under ~/.paperclip/cli and can register a background service.
From source: git clone, pnpm install, pnpm dev (API at http://localhost:3100, embedded Postgres).
Telemetry is enabled by default; disable with PAPERCLIP_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 or DO_NOT_TRACK=1 for bench runs.
Guest CLIs must already be installed and authenticated; Paperclip does not replace them.

research.positioning: An open-source, self-hosted control plane for running teams of AI agents as a 'company'—org chart, goals, budgets, governance, and heartbeats—where the workers are guest coding CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, OpenCode, Pi, …) executing ticketed issues in isolated git-worktree workspaces. Marketed broadly as 'manage AI agents for work' ('Manage business goals, not pull requests'), with software engineering as the most developed execution path.

infrastructure: Default path: single local Node.js process with embedded Postgres and local file storage, loopback bind, no login (local_trusted).
Authenticated private/public modes for LAN/Tailscale/cloud exposure; one deployment can host many isolated companies.
Agent runs resolve a project/execution workspace (git worktrees, operator branches) and can start runtime services (dev servers, preview URLs).
Guest CLIs use the operator's own credentials; managed git/gh launchers broker GitHub identity per run when a GitHub connection is configured.
Optional sandbox/cloud execution providers (e2b, Cloudflare, Daytona, Modal, Novita, self-hosted Kubernetes) per roadmap/plugins.

verify work from diffs, screenshots and tests (README pillar)

context_memory: persistent agent session state across heartbeats
runtime skill injection, Skill Studio, shared company skills

parity_risks: Guest agent/model dominates single-task correctness (runtime_model guest-cli).
Company/org setup, CEO agent, and approval gates add overhead and human interventions not present in simpler cockpits; use a single engineer agent and record every approval.
Heartbeat-driven execution adds latency; wall-clock comparisons must note heartbeat interval.
Execution workspaces may be git worktrees outside runs/<run-id>/worktree—verify where edits land.
Telemetry on by default; disable for bench runs.
Fast calendar-versioned releases; pin the npm version.

hypotheses: The 'agent company' abstraction (goals, org chart, budgets, governance) differentiates from worktree cockpits that manage sessions, not organizations.
Massive OSS adoption and plugin/adapter ecosystem create community lock-in for agent orchestration.
Atomic checkout, budgets, and audit trails target unattended 24/7 operation rather than interactive pairing.
evidence: README documents systems for heartbeat execution, worktree workspaces, governance, budgets, plugins, and company portability.
Official adapter docs list ten+ local/remote runtime adapters; packages/adapters ships them in-repo.
GitHub repo shows ~84k stars, MIT license, and frequent releases (v2026.916.1 on 2026-09-21).
unknowns: Head-to-head coding-task quality vs Paseo/Compozy/Emdash is unscored.
Share of users running coding vs non-coding 'business' agents is not published.
